_comment: Вторые клипы ужина (чередование в сцене ~90 с, Директор 09.11 01:19 «доделываем»): те же 4 картины, другой рисунок движения, чтобы клипы A и B различались.

frames.prompt: Static camera, warm candlelit room. Everyone keeps their seats. The man nods slowly and glances at the old woman; the old woman turns her head a little toward the young woman at the samovar and smiles; the woman in the shawl lowers her eyes to her bowl and looks up again. The candle flame sways, a glint runs over the samovar, snow drifts past the window, the cat on the stove stretches a paw. Nobody stands up, no hands move the dishes or the cup. Painterly look unchanged, no new elements. Ends exactly in the starting pose.
